title: Pure Amorphage
summary: Pure Amorphage Pendulum stun with Amorphactor Pain, the Imagination Dracoverlord and Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon. Every Amorphage monster locks the opponent out of the Extra Deck while on the field and applies a different floodgate in the Pendulum Zone.

summary.title: Consistency & Starters
points: Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon discards itself and pays 500 LP to search any Level 8 or lower Dragon Pendulum Monster from the Deck, giving direct access to Amorphage Goliath, Amorphage Sloth or whichever Scale floodgate you need.

Amorphage Infection boosts all Amorphage monsters by 100 ATK/DEF for each Amorphage card on the field and searches any Amorphage card from the Deck whenever a monster in your hand or field is Tributed or destroyed.
Amorphous Persona boosts Amorphage stats by 300, draws a card up to twice per turn whenever an Amorphage monster is Tributed, and banishes itself from the GY to Ritual Summon Amorphactor Pain.

summary.title: Opening: Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon + Infection/Persona
steps: Discard Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon and pay 500 LP to search a missing Scale 3 (such as Amorphage Sloth, Greed or Pride) or Scale 5 (such as Lechery, Gluttony or Envy).
Activate Amorphage Infection and Amorphous Persona, then set a Scale 3 and Scale 5 Amorphage pair to Pendulum Summon Level 4 Amorphages.

During your Standby Phase, Tribute a Pendulum Summoned Amorphage to pay your Scale's maintenance cost—triggering Amorphage Infection to search another Amorphage card and Amorphous Persona to draw a card—then Pendulum Summon the Tributed monster back from the Extra Deck on your Main Phase.

summary.title: Pendulum Floodgate Matrix
points: On the field: any Pendulum Summoned or flipped Amorphage prevents the opponent from Special Summoning from the Extra Deck; Amorphage Goliath (Level 8) and Amorphage Sloth (Level 6) apply this Extra Deck lock even when Normal or Tribute Summoned.

Spell & Trap Locks (Scales): Amorphage Lechery (Scale 5) prevents Spell activations, Amorphage Greed (Scale 3) prevents Trap activations, and Amorphage Envy (Scale 5) prevents either player from chaining as Chain Link 2 or higher.

Monster, Search & GY Locks (Scales): Amorphage Gluttony (Scale 5) stops monster effect activations, Amorphage Sloth (Scale 3) stops adding cards from the Deck to the hand except by drawing, Amorphage Goliath (Scale 5) banishes all cards sent to the GY, and Amorphage Wrath (Scale 3) prevents Tributing non-Amorphage monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Control: Amorphactor Pain & Lysis
points: Amorphactor Pain, the Imagination Dracoverlord is Ritual Summoned by banishing Amorphous Persona from the GY and Tributing Pendulum Monsters whose Levels equal 8; it skips the opponent's next Main Phase 1 and negates the effects of all Fusion, Synchro and Xyz Monsters on the field.

Amorphage Lysis weakens all non-Amorphage monsters by 100 ATK/DEF per Amorphage card on the field, and immediately places a new Amorphage from your Deck into the Pendulum Zone whenever a card in your Pendulum Zone is destroyed, keeping Scales up even if you skip paying their Standby Phase Tribute.

main: Amorphage Goliath
Scale 5 Level 8 boss that banishes any card sent to the GY while in the Pendulum Zone.
Amorphage Sloth
Scale 3 Level 6 monster that prevents both players from adding cards from the Deck to the hand except by drawing.
Amorphage Pride
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from taking effect damage and serves as a Normal Summonable lock.
Amorphage Wrath
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from Tributing monsters, except Amorphage monsters.
Amorphage Envy
Scale 5 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from activating cards or effects as Chain Link 2 or higher.
Amorphage Greed
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from activating Trap Cards and their effects.
Amorphage Lechery
Scale 5 Level 2 monster that prevents both players from activating Spell Cards and their effects, except Amorphage Spells.
Amorphage Gluttony
Scale 5 Level 2 monster that prevents monsters from activating their effects, except Amorphage monsters.
Amorphactor Pain, the Imagination Dracoverlord
Ritual boss summoned by Amorphous Persona that skips the opponent's Main Phase 1.
Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon
Consistency booster that searches Sloth, Goliath, or any Scale 3/5 Amorphage Dragon.
Amorphage Infection
Continuous Spell that boosts ATK/DEF and searches any Amorphage card when a monster is Tributed or destroyed.
Amorphous Persona
Field Spell that boosts Amorphage stats, draws up to 2 cards per turn on Tribute, and Ritual Summons Amorphactor Pain.
Amorphage Lysis
Continuous Trap that weakens non-Amorphage monsters and immediately replaces destroyed Pendulum Scales from the Deck.
